findings.evidence: GET http://localhost:8000/api/login → 401 Unauthorized on kiosk idle page load. Single occurrence, only on S1-01. No corresponding /api/login GET route exists in routes/api.php and no JS code in resources/js does an axios.get('login'). Most likely browser-side Saved-Passwords autofill probe (Chrome / Edge sniff '/api/login' on form pages) or stale service-worker prefetch. NO DOM toast, NO console error visible to user, NO order-flow impact. The idle screen renders normally and the full kiosk flow (idle → categories → wizard → cart → upsell → payment → cash-instruction) proceeds without issue.
findings.fix_hint: No actionable source — origin is likely browser-runtime not application JS. Would require web-vitals trace to confirm. NOT scope-minimal for V1.
findings.dispute_outcome: kept as INFO — surfaced for the record only. The REVIEWER_PROTOCOL allowlist explicitly covers '401 on /api/auth/logout' as benign; a 401 on a non-existent /api/login probe is analogous (the SPA catchall returns the auth gate, not a silent 200). Per goal 'no useless complexity V1' — do not chase.
findings.applied: no — info only, no fix attempted

findings.evidence: On the /kiosk/cash-instruction screen (S1-10), a transient top-right toast renders: '⚠ Trop de requêtes — patientez 22s avant de réessayer.' (i18n key error.rate_limited, FR). Source: POST /api/frontend/kiosk/event returned 429 (throttle:30,1 in routes/api.php:1394). The global axios 429 interceptor (resources/js/bootstrap.js:182-200, added by Wave Y RATE-LIMIT 2026-05-21) surfaces ALL 429s as user-facing toasts including telemetry endpoints (frontend/kiosk-event, frontend/kiosk/event). The CashInstruction screen's own logEvent() handler does have `.catch(() => {})` (KioskCashInstructionComponent.vue:128) but the global interceptor fires the toast BEFORE the per-call catch swallows. NO order-flow impact — the cash instruction renders correctly with order #A0001 + 7,80 €. The 429 is on a fire-and-forget telemetry endpoint that does not impact the order trail or NF525 chain. Customer impact: visual noise on the final-step screen during high-cadence operation (test ran 30+ kiosk events in 37s; real customer cadence is far below 30/min, but a lunchtime rush across multiple terminals at one IP COULD hit the per-IP throttle).
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) the global 429 interceptor in resources/js/bootstrap.js should allowlist telemetry endpoints (frontend/kiosk-event, frontend/kiosk/event, csp-report) so they fail silently — ~6 LOC diff but BLAST RADIUS = every surface (POS, KDS, admin) which is a policy decision, OR (b) raise telemetry throttle from 30/min to 120/min for kiosk-event (single-line in routes/api.php). Option (a) is the more correct fix (telemetry should ALWAYS be silent best-effort). Owner-gate recommended because the change affects toast surfacing across all surfaces.
findings.dispute_outcome: kept as P1 IMPROVEMENT — deferred. (1) Real-customer impact at single-terminal cadence: low — analytics fires ~1 event per cart-mutation, real users do ~10 mutations/order, well below 30/min. (2) Multi-terminal lunchtime: medium — 4 terminals × 10 events × 3 orders in 1 min = 120 events, throttle hit. (3) Visual leak on cash-instruction screen erodes V1 trust. (4) NOT applied because the fix touches resources/js/bootstrap.js which is non-frozen but blast-radius = every surface (POS/KDS/admin/kiosk) and is an architectural policy decision (do telemetry 429s ever surface? — owner-gate per brief 'If an improvement requires architectural decision, classify CRITICAL'). Surfaced to owner for V1.0.2 decision.
findings.applied: no — owner-gate required (architectural policy decision per brief)

verdict_rationale: 9/10 states render perfectly with valid FR-only catalog, perfect numeric integrity (cart Cheddar €0,90 + Tacos €6,90 = €7,80 carried unchanged through cart → upsell → payment hero → cash-instruction order card, 3 surfaces consistent down to the centime), zero raw i18n keys, zero application console errors of substance, zero frozen-zone touch, dine-in guard correctly collapses 'Sur place' tile (V1 per feedback_v1_dine_in_disabled_2026-05-06), Wave Y catalog refresh (commit d8bcbe5f5) visible, dark-mode kill (commit 04a3a9b3d) holds, pre-flight prune fix (commit 6f226ef67) is regression-safe (clean cart passes through Valider → upsell → payment without 422 or toast). State S1-10 surfaces a P1 IMPROVEMENT (telemetry 429 visible toast on the cash-instruction screen) that is NOT a P0 (no order/fiscal impact) but IS a UX quality issue at multi-terminal lunchtime cadence. Defer for owner-gate per brief (architectural policy: should telemetry 429s ever surface to the user?). One INFO (P3) for environmental noise (browser autofill probe).
goal_alignment_note: All findings stay within V1 single-resto FR goal scope. The 1 deferred P1 IMPROVEMENT is exactly the type of '20% the owner hasn't caught' that the brief asked us to surface. NO NF525 risk, NO frozen-zone touch, NO sync break observed.
